name: Nanjing functional area
limitations: Eight dimensions and31 subpillars reviewed at a conditional/partial level, not fully measured. PCS/GSS/ISR/RES60, LON/OPT40, TEC80 andMED unresolved give mathematical domain49-64, without a total centre or reliable exclusion bound. MED current quality interpretation and ordinary necessary-care/payer/alternative linkage remain under review; specialists and historical cohorts do not fill the score. Locality, continuity, usual-citizen qualification, affordability and residual materiality remain reversible. Administrative, institutional, cloud and multicentre totals are not whole-FUA or median-resident measures; missing is not zero, negative transparency evidence or a ranking exclusion.

dimensions.rationale: Actual cooling-space use, rain pump operation and measured local water-level reduction, completed geohazard remediation and storm drainage repairs establish usable protection. Old-city drainage defects and a2025 actual cracked/tilted landslide retaining wall remain. Design procurement and wildfire teams are not repaired slopes or measured all-resident safety.
dimensions.assumption: Accept limited local/core-city protection results as representative of ordinary9701 citizens, continuing through cutoff, with remaining heat/building/drainage/geohazard constraints materially limited after delivered mitigation. Scope and continuity remain assumptions, not citywide loss rates. Important residual protection gaps could support40; broader effective protection and affordable backup80. Reject locality/representativeness/continuity/materiality to restore unknown.

dimensions.rationale: A primary prosecutor interview records long-running organized cases56+5 with4 serious and12 minor injuries,2024 indictment and2025 hearing. These are cumulative cases, not current victim rates or convictions. Regional military exercises and strategic transport exposure remain separate from actual local attack. Current alarm tests and community response exercises are usable but not wartime adequate coverage.
dimensions.assumption: Accept current ordinary-life/core-route impacts as limited and local enforcement/response as normally usable despite retained organized harm and regional threats. No UCDP matched event does not establish absent violence. Continuing material gang coercion or strategic channel restriction could support40; wider low-impact and effective-alternative evidence80. Reject time/locality/impact/response representativeness to restore unknown.

dimensions.rationale: Delivered legal aid, wage recovery, community property-service fallback, hotline correction and completed residential-fire remediation establish current execution. The2024 Mingshang Xiyuan fire killed15 with late detection/evacuation and property/regulatory failures;10 criminal measures are not convictions. The affected households long-term rehousing/compensation tail remains unmeasured. Hotline90.1% and completed remediation counts are not all-resident resolution or full recovery.
dimensions.assumption: Accept normally reachable current core services and sufficiently effective continuing remediation, with the known failures and unmeasured recovery tail not constituting a wider important persistent unmitigated barrier. This assumption is especially contestable: actual continuing victim-recovery or repeated fire-safety barriers could strengthen40 without majority harm. Broader rights/recovery results and usable alternatives80. Missing recovery evidence itself is not a penalty; if necessary scope/continuity/access/materiality cannot be defended, restore unknown.

dimensions.rationale: Actual2025Q1 water monitoring reports72 compliant samples:10plant,52terminal,10secondary, not72terminal or full-FUA household coverage. A2026H1 utility report gives average household outage below0.05h, not no outage for every resident; planned UHV and year-end monitoring are not delivered. Actual wholesale arrivals and working trade channels coexist with external dependence,2026 rural pipe/pressure/repair constraints and partially completed upgrades. An already operating Pingshan pressure station and170km completed pipes are scoped mitigation, not full project completion.
dimensions.assumption: Accept current core water/energy/food provision and delivered rural mitigation as reasonably representative and usually usable/affordable for ordinary9701 citizens, continuing through cutoff, with residual supply, household pressure and external/common-channel constraints important weaknesses but not an important overall unmitigated bottleneck. Price observations, average outages and sampled compliance do not prove median-resident budgets or full local coverage. Evidence of important remaining unmet necessities or shared-channel constraints after mitigation could support40, more effective affordable backup80; reject locality/resident/continuity/affordability/materiality assumptions to restore unknown.

dimensions.rationale: Actual2025 hospital/community admissions and surgery,2024 regional referrals and two hospital remedial processes establish delivery. Gulou2018-2024 thrombus214-person retrospective care and2013-2021 aortic1295-person surgery establish scoped actual treatment, not current full-area quality or causal therapy effects. Aortic table77/645AKI deaths conflicts with正文71; fully adjusted thrombus-dissolution association is nonsignificant. TCM2025 acknowledges quality-control and acute/complex-care weaknesses with implemented management/training; claims of improvement, plans and service volumes are not proof all failures resolved. Current usual insurance has registration/payment/provider/clinical conditions; specific outpatient-disease inpatient relief does not cover every treatment or prove net household affordability.
dimensions.assumption: No anchor selected while substantive current quality interpretation, usable timely alternatives and ordinary legally insured necessary-care access/payment/continuity across9701 remain under review. This is an incomplete discriminating clinical/resident chain, not a requirement for a perfect population denominator or a penalty from missing originals. A defensible usually adequate and affordable multi-provider path could support60; material unrelieved care/quality/wait/payment bottlenecks40, wider clinical results and pressure backup80. Historical high-risk case mix or data conflicts alone do not choose a tier. Other dimensions do not fill MED.

dimensions.rationale: Shared randomized human evidence and Chinese disease-specific approval connect to actual Nanjing First Hospital treatment in a seven-hospital cohort.407 treated and321 monitored MRI records are not Nanjing counts;39ARIA and4symptomaticARIA use321,15 mixed subjective withdrawals are not all financial. A local primary2026 interview records eligible patients foregoing treatment because of cost, ongoing hospital-supply barriers and current30%-or-higher reimbursement for some supplementary-insured patients. Usual basic insurance does not presume voluntary Ninghuibao enrollment or these antibodies coverage.
dimensions.assumption: Accept limited disease-specific readiness relevance, local actual appropriate treatment and monitoring continuity, with economic/transport/supply barriers remaining important for eligible ordinary citizens after actual supplementary-insurance mitigation. Not inferred from missing complete bills, brands or income averages. Usual sufficiently affordable whole-course access could support60, broader mature pathways80; reject locality/representativeness/continuity/remaining materiality to restore unknown.

dimensions.rationale: Southeast University actual licenses/transfers, separately reported manufacturing and production-line observation, deployed enterprise5G and actually used digital services/elderly training establish multiple producers and diffusion. Institution/group turnover and contracts are not all local realized revenue,36.8wan service visits and7.3wan training visits are not unique citizens. Financing/skill barriers and actual funding/assistance remain together. Directory article associations only sequence research.
dimensions.assumption: Accept multiple production nodes, current adoption and delivered assistance as reasonably representative of9701 core industry and usual citizens and continuing through cutoff, with remaining finance/device/skill constraints materially mitigated rather than an important general diffusion break. No perfect output denominator or failure-switching test is imposed only here. Evidence of important remaining diffusion barriers could support60, a major production-to-use break40; reject locality/resident relevance/continuity/mitigation assumptions to restore unknown.

dimensions.rationale: Actual Lukou air traffic, rail and metro channels coexist with conditional German skilled-worker national-visa application and lawful current-account/settled-emigrant asset paths.USD50000 is a convenient FX allowance, not an all-transfer ceiling; capital purposes and prior permanent-status sequencing matter. Actual Nanjing Tencent-cloud probes found479 blocked outbound domains while domestic controls worked; cloud measurements are not household failure rates. Operator event assurance and official roaming are mitigation, not proof all critical cross-border services work affordably.
dimensions.assumption: Accept asset-purpose/order constraints and measured selective cross-border blocking as important to ordinary citizens core initial-migration resources and key contacts after existing transport/bank/phone mitigation. Cloud-node physical locality, household applicability,2024-to-cutoff continuity and residual importance remain assumptions. Usual lawful affordable financial and communication alternatives supporting key purposes could support60, stronger tested alternatives80. Reject these assumptions to restore unknown; normal destination qualification alone is not denial, and restrictions are not an overall inability to leave.

researchPriority.rule: All9031 candidates sorted by descending qualifying core nonretracted article-ID directory associations then numeric efua_id; skip20 registered reviews only to sequence research. No output/quality score, eligibility or exclusion.
